question: Is the initial experimental `claws update` contract acceptable when failed external package, source-config, or Gateway calls stop at `update_partial` and require status/Doctor inspection plus a fresh plan, rather than durable operation-identity reconciliation?
rationale: The implementation can fail closed and report uncertainty, but only repository owners can choose whether that operator-recovery contract is acceptable for this new lifecycle capability.

options.title: Require reconciliation before merge
options.body: Keep the mutation executor unmerged until it has a durable operation identity and a documented retry/reconcile path for uncertain package and Gateway outcomes.

options.title: Accept the limited experimental contract
options.body: Merge only after exact-head live proof demonstrates the fail-closed `update_partial` path and the owner accepts status/Doctor plus a fresh plan as the temporary recovery workflow.

recommendation.title: Require reconciliation before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the mutation executor unmerged until it has a durable operation identity and a documented retry/reconcile path for uncertain package and Gateway outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest integration fix on the active head.
